release.content: pubrules 0.47.0 was released on 2026-11-19 from commit 7e039c9242d6cd4ee7248fe7c9f6f6ebb2bbf149 with these changes.

rows: pubrules holds no version of another package: the managed tests/requirements-pubrules.txt names pubtest as a floor (pubtest>=0.2.2) and each repository's tests/requirements.txt pins the wheel; pubrel, pubsec and pubdeploy are each repository's own pins (ci.release.pubrel, deploy.providers, or what the workflows and launchers already pin), which the nightly moves to their latest releases; where a repository has none yet, pubrules new, init and sync take the release the PUBRULES_RELEASES release-state file lists, or else the latest GitHub release

The reusable workflows install their apt packages (the apt-packages input, and the cross job's linker and emulator) through actions/apt-install, so a job whose packages and runner image an earlier run had installs them from the Actions cache without recommended packages; their uses of retry and terraform-init move to v0.46.0 with it, so terraform-init reads pubrules.json's provider mirror; job-service-tests and service-ci take apt-packages too, which a service's or content repository's ci block sets in with
The new Rust repository's .gitignore, and pubrules' own, ignore .venv as a link too, so pubrel 0.8's prepare, which links the checkout's .venv into its worktree, no longer commits it
